craft_notes: Sthāyin: rising-verse. Sanskrit: āmūlāt...sūkṣmatarātmikam cintayet tāṃ dviṣaṭkānte śyāmyantīm bhairavodayaḥ → L4 keeps the tenor: contemplate-her-at-twelve-end → Bhairava's-rise. Rows: row 3 (from-root/from-subtle pair). Close: rise (bhairavodaya). Rejected: 'kuṇḍalinī' — killed: her/she kept (name withheld — same discipline as saktavijnana); 'suprarenal' — killed: ray-shining kept.

lines: From root ray-shining, from subtle subtler-natured:
contemplate her at twelve's end — calming, Bhairava's rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āmūlāt kiraṇābhāsāṃ sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarātmikam | cintayet tāṃ dviṣaṭkānte śyāmyantīm bhairavodayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What should be contemplated? → Contemplating the subtler at the twelve-end, calming, rises Bhairava.
c1_essence: Subtler contempler at twelve-end: calming, Bhairava's rise.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
